title: Hayden Panettiere’s Music Career, ‘Nashville’ & Beyond: 5 Things to Know
summary: The actress charted country hits & even earned a Grammy nomination.
body: Hayden Panettiere , the actress and singer best known for her roles in Heroes , Scream and Nashville , died Sunday at age 36 . While Panettiere sculpted an enduring acting career beginning as a child, her work in music was an equally memorable part of her legacy — particularly through her role as country star Juliette Barnes on Nashville . As Juliette, Panettiere performed dozens of songs throughout the ABC musical drama’s six-season run, many of which were released commercially through the show’s soundtrack albums. Her performances weren’t simply incidental to the series. Panettiere’s recordings made their way onto Billboard ‘s country charts, giving the actress a legitimate chart history of her own. Her rendition of “Telescope,” for example, became one of the best-known songs associated with her Nashville character, while recordings including “Undermine,” “Wrong Song” and “Don’t Put Dirt on My Grave Just Yet” also charted. title: A Timeline of Cardi B & BIA’s Feud
summary: The rivalry was renewed on Thursday (Aug. 13).
body: After exchanging diss tracks in the past, all seemed to be calm on the BIA and Cardi B front for much of 2026. That all changed last Thursday (Aug. 13) when BIA doubled down on her claims made on “SUE MEEE?,” which led to Cardi unleashing on the “Whole Lotta Money” rapper hours later. The feud stretches back to 2023, when BIA aligned herself with Cardi’s rival, Nicki Minaj, as they teamed up on “Whole Lotta Money” in 2020, and fans noticed BIA allegedly scrubbed her X account of Cardi-praising posts she had made in the past. However, BIA said they had no problems. Still, in 2024, Cardi and BIA threw their names into the rap beef ring. BIA shaded the Grammy-winning artist over alleged similarities between BIA’s Really Her EP and Cardi’s “Enough (Miami).” She also appeared to take issue with Cardi interpolating Missy Elliott’s 1999 hit “She’s a Bitch” on “Like What (Freestyle),” which BIA sampled a year before on “I’m That Bitch.” BIA brought the feud into the studio and released her “SUE MEEE?” diss track, in which she blasted Cardi over claims of infi…

title: Bad Bunny to Close Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour in Puerto Rico
summary: The two-night show will take place Aug. 22 and 23, with tickets going on sale Wednesday.
body: After a year of performances across the globe, Bad Bunny is going out with a bang — at home. Benito Antonio Martínez Ocasio is bringing the Debí Tirar Más Fotos World Tour to Puerto Rico to close out more than a year of performances worldwide. According to a press release issued Monday (Aug. 17), the two-night event is scheduled for Aug. 22 and 23 at Hiram Bithorn Stadium in San Juan.
